items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: As far as I know, he recorded this also in 1953 for the Clef label with Gene Krupa.

ctx.x: Now the Kirby Band featured a composition called "Opus No. 5," but this is not the tune that resembles "Opus de Funk." That is something that comes from Chopin.
The theme that does resemble it is a Charlie Shavers compositon called "Swedish Schapps." As far as I know, he recorded this also in 1953 for the Clef label with Gene Krupa.
